description: zcode-token-usage-statusbar 插件市场：ZCode token 用量查询（MCP / 命令 / 技能）与自动安装/修复桌面悬浮状态条（始终开启，修改 app.asar，成功后需完全退出并重开）。
name: zusage-marketplace

plugins.description: ZCode token 用量查询（token_usage MCP 工具 + /usage 命令 + 技能，读本地 usage 数据库）；桌面客户端未注入时始终尝试自动安装/修复悬浮用量状态条（修改 app.asar，成功后需完全退出并重开；旧自动安装开关不再生效，/uninstall-overlay 可阻止自动重注入）；每次回答末尾自动追加逐问速率行（由前端确定性渲染，依赖 renderer 桥；即时 tok/s 含思考、首字延迟、输出 token、生成耗时、段数/峰值与会话累计，--current 守卫防旧数据充数）。

description_i18n.en: ZCode token usage query via the token_usage MCP tool, /usage command, and skill (reads the local usage DB). Auto-installs the desktop floating usage status bar whenever the client is not injected (always on; legacy auto-install config keys are no longer read; /uninstall-overlay blocks re-injection; modifies app.asar - fully quit and reopen ZCode to take effect). Appends a per-answer rate line at the end of each reply (rendered deterministically via the renderer bridge; tok/s, TTFT, output tokens).

plugins.name: zcode-token-usage-statusbar
